title: Seller Performance Standing Action-Plan Cap for Long-Tenured Records
content:
**Cap schedule.** The action-plan cap is the long-tenure action-plan cap of 5 points for a standing record opened 1,095 days or more before the handling date, and the mid-tenure action-plan cap of 4 points for a record opened at least 730 but fewer than 1,095 days before. A record opened fewer than 730 days before the handling date takes neither of these caps.

The days are counted from the date the seller's Seller Performance Standing record was opened to the handling date.

| Days since the standing record was opened | Action-plan cap |
|---|---|
| 1,095 or more | 5 points |
| at least 730, fewer than 1,095 | 4 points |
| fewer than 730 | neither of these caps |

## Points of judgement

- **Exactly 1,095 days?** The long-tenure cap of 5 points: "1,095 days or more" includes the day itself. At 1,094 days the cap is 4 points.
- **Exactly 730 days?** The mid-tenure cap of 4 points. At 729 days neither cap in this schedule applies.
- **Hypothetical application.** Action-plan relief points of 6 on a record opened 1,100 days before the handling date are held at 5; on a record opened 900 days before, at 4.
